slice: CAP-038 empty registered synthesis source references
contract: Every registered public provenance view appears in the source manifest, including views with zero rows; non-location scope labels are retained.
failure_behavior: The signed worker rejects a collector result that omits any registered provenance view before returning or invoking the draft writer; the read transaction is rolled back and closed.
limitations: This preserves source identity and count when a view is empty; it is not content-level snapshot or populated-output parity evidence.
Live OIDC, production grants, runtime recovery, and MAN-CAP-038 owner acceptance remain open.
